name: Half-Kneeling Cable Chop
cues: Kneel side-on to a high pulley with the near knee down
Hold the rope above your near shoulder with both hands
Pull down and across toward your far hip
Keep your hips square and still as your torso turns

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: Sides check out: the right (near, pulley-side) knee is down, the left foot is planted ahead, and the pelvis is fixed with hips square. The rope chops from (-0.42, 1.43) to the far hip (+0.50, 0.72), with thorax rot -28..30 and lumbar -10..12 deg. From t 0.375 to 0.75 the far forearm hides the face in the default camera, and at 12272/12288 bytes the compact size has 16 bytes of headroom, so any later tweak will overflow.
